Method of Attack: Malicious PyPI packages contain minimal local code but import and download additional malicious packages from third-party GitHub repositories at runtime
Downloaded packages steal Minecraft game configuration files and exfiltrate data via encrypted Discord webhook URLs
Discoverer: 奇安信技术研究星图实验室
Impacted Systems: Minecraft game users (due to stolen Minecraft configuration files and possible account credential theft)
Attack Vector: PyPI packages specify third-party GitHub repositories as download sources for malicious code
Runtime import triggers download and installation of malicious packages from GitHub
Use of pip's ability to specify package download URLs to evade detection
Indicators of Compromise: Discord webhook URL hidden behind bit.ly short link: https://bit.ly/3SMNBRz
Malicious package names: hypixelmc, hypixelmcapi, hymcapi, startuptools, discordwebconfig
